description: List the purchaseable object categories in the world catalog. Prerequisite: none — read-only catalog query, no build permission required. Effect: returns the set of whitelisted categories (12..20) that have at least one purchaseable, non-blacklisted item in Content.WorldCatalog, with item counts and both integer ID and slug name. Cost: none — no simoleon debit, no PDU emitted. Use this before search-catalog to discover which categories are browsable.
call_signatures: cf $CF list-catalog-categories   # returns categories array with id, name/slug, count
common_mistakes: Only categories 12..20 (the server roommate whitelist) are returned — admin/special categories are excluded.
A category with count=0 will not appear (only categories with ≥1 purchaseable item are listed).
perception_hints: Use this before search-catalog to discover which category IDs and slugs are valid.
